BSE Limited    
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers,

Trading Symbol: EPL 
 
Sub. :  Audio recording of Investor’s Conference Call – EPL Limited (“Company”) 
 
Ref. :  1.  Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (as amended) (“SEBI LODR Regulations”) 
 
 
2.  ISIN: INE255A01020 
 
Sir/ Madam,  
 
This is in furtherance of our intimation dated August 4, 2026, whereby we had intimated regarding a 
conference call for the Analysts/ Investors scheduled to be held today i.e. on August 11, 2026, to 
discuss the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter 
ended on June 30, 2026 (“said Conference call”).   
  
In that regard and in terms of the above referred provisions of SEBI LODR Regulations, please note 
that the said Conference Call was held today, as per the schedule intimated earlier, and the audio 
recording for the said Conference call is made available on the website of the Company i.e. at 
https://www.eplglobal.com/news-media/#multimedia . 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully,  
For EPL Limited 
 
 
 
Onkar Ghangurde 
Head - Legal, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
